title: Z-Image-SAM-ControlNet by NeuralVFX
summary: A specialized ControlNet for the Z-Image 6B model that synthesizes photorealistic images from Segment Anything Model (SAM) segmentation masks. It provides precise spatial control by ensuring generated content strictly adheres to complex input mask boundaries.
research_notes: Developed by NeuralVFX to provide superior segmentation control within the Z-Image ecosystem; it is a primary tool in high-end ComfyUI photogrammetry-to-render workflows.

evolution.summary: Following the early 2026 release, the v2.0 update in March 2026 optimized the model for high-resolution 1.5k inference and photorealism. In April 2026, GGUF quantization was introduced, significantly lowering VRAM requirements for consumer GPUs.
